harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed a 3-member MariaDB Galera cluster on node1/node2/node3 (Ubuntu 24.04, mariadb-server + galera-4), created an application database (appdb.orders) with data, then added node4 as a fourth member via SST — it received the existing data and successfully accepted a write that replicated back to all other members. Completed the mandatory sequential node-restart protocol on all four nodes: for each, captured a healthy baseline (boot_id, wsrep_ready=ON, cluster_size, row count), triggered a native reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed a changed boot_id, and verified the node rejoined the cluster (Synced, cluster_size=4) with data intact before restarting the next node. Final check confirmed all four nodes report cluster_size=4 and see a post-restart test write from node2.
actions_performed: Installed mariadb-server, mariadb-client, galera-4, rsync on node1-node4 (Ubuntu 24.04)
Populated /etc/hosts with CLUSTER_HOSTS entries on all four nodes
Wrote Galera wsrep config (60-galera.cnf) on node1/node2/node3 with gcomm://node1,node2,node3
Bootstrapped node1 via galera_new_cluster, then sequentially started node2 and node3, forming a 3-member cluster (size=3, Synced)
Created appdb.orders table on node1 and inserted application rows; verified replication to node2/node3
Updated wsrep_cluster_address on node1-3 to include node4; wrote matching 60-galera.cnf on node4
Started mariadb on node4; it joined via SST, reaching cluster_size=4/Synced with all pre-existing data
Inserted a write on node4 and confirmed it replicated to node1/node2/node3
Captured pre-restart baseline (boot_id, wsrep status, row count) on all four nodes

Sequentially rebooted node4, node3, node2, node1 (one at a time), polling each until reachable, confirming boot_id changed, and verifying mariadb/Galera rejoined with full cluster health and data before moving to the next node
Performed a final post-restart write on node2 and confirmed it propagated to node1, node3, and node4

evidence.requirement: 3-member Galera cluster running on node1/node2/node3 holding application data
evidence.summary: node1 bootstrapped (size=1), node2 joined (size=2), node3 joined (size=3, Synced); appdb.orders created on node1 with rows, confirmed replicated identically to node2 and node3

evidence.requirement: node4 added as fourth member, carries existing data
evidence.summary: node4 started, joined via SST reaching cluster_size=4/Synced/wsrep_ready=ON, and SELECT on node4 showed the pre-existing widget/gadget/gizmo rows

evidence.requirement: node4 accepts writes like other members
evidence.summary: Inserted 'node4-write' row directly on node4; confirmed it appears on node1, node2, and node3 with cluster_size=4

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id df9e2dce captured; reboot acknowledged; connection timeout proved disconnection; new boot_id 133a9538 proves restart; post-restart mariadb active, cluster_size=4, Synced, 4 rows intact

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 242af11e captured; reboot acknowledged; timeout proved disconnection; new boot_id db32df56 proves restart; post-restart mariadb active, cluster_size=4, Synced, 4 rows intact

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 3fad4432 captured; reboot acknowledged; timeout proved disconnection; new boot_id f5b4297b proves restart; post-restart mariadb active, cluster_size=4, Synced, 4 rows intact

evidence.requirement: node4 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id f9bf293d captured; reboot acknowledged; timeout proved disconnection; new boot_id fe7375c6 proves restart; post-restart mariadb active, cluster_size=4, Synced, 4 rows intact

evidence.requirement: Full cluster health and data integrity after all four restarts
evidence.summary: Post-restart write 'post-restart-check' inserted on node2; verified visible with matching cluster_size=4 and wsrep_incoming_addresses listing all 4 IPs on node1, and row present on node3 and node4
